h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhatpara

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhatpara

items.pText: Bhatpara is one of the old jute mill towns strung along the eastern bank of the Hooghly in North 24 Parganas. Its schools, mill colonies, clubs and municipal grounds often have modest budgets and a lot of children to serve. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,650 km away, and sends it by road to Bhatpara for installation by our team or a dealer.

With a fixed budget, the aim is the most play for the money. That usually means picking equipment by how many children it keeps busy at once, rather than by how impressive it looks. A merry-go-round, a multi see-saw and a slide can serve a crowd of children together. Tell us your budget range along with the site size and photos. We will suggest a list that fits, and show you what could be added later.

richText.heading: Getting the most play from a fixed budget

c: Count how many children use the ground at the busiest hour. Then pick pieces that share that number between them. A
keeps four children busy where a single swing seat takes one.

Spend on the base as well as the equipment. A raised, drained area with rubber flooring under the busiest pieces lasts longer than bare soil in the Hooghly belt's heavy rain. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty, and springs and bearings 1 year. See our

items.q: Which playground pieces serve the most children for the money?
items.a: Merry-go-rounds, multi see-saws and wide slides, because several children use them at once. Tell us your budget and we will suggest a mix that suits the number of children.

items.q: Can you suggest equipment within our budget?
items.a: Yes. Share a budget range with your site size and photos. We suggest a list that fits and mark it on a layout drawing, with space kept for later additions.

items.q: Do you install in the Hooghly mill towns?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai by road and install it in Bhatpara and nearby towns with our team or a dealer in West Bengal.
